note: City of Amery campground in North Park by the Apple River, just north of downtown on WI-46 opposite the North Twin Lake boat landing, with a canoe launch, fishing pier and trail access. --Claude
summary: City page + brochure confirm 8 improved 50A/W/S sites at $35, phone reservations or weekend self-registration, 7-night max, showers, $10 dump, WiFi. Stored pin is ~750 m off, on a mobile-home park; the sites are at ~45.3197,-92.3597. Not waterfront kept.
flags: PIN MOVE ~750 m: stored 45.3262,-92.3570 sits beside a mobile-home park north of town. The campground (RVs on the north side of North Park's loop road, Google pin 45.3196,-92.3598) is at about 45.3197,-92.3597.

WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' kept: the RV sites line the north side of the park road with the park lawn, tennis courts and playground between them and the Apple River side of the park; no site is near the water.

SEASONAL: the page also rents seasonal sites at $650 a month but does not say how many or whether they are among the 8; the old note said 2. Imagery shows about five RVs along the row. Google 4.5 (13).
PHONE 715-268-7486 (City Hall) and WEBSITE confirmed. The brochure omits sewer; the current web page lists it, so sewer stays true.
SEASON: no dates posted; none written.
